executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 43 errors across multiple files. The root cause is missing Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3 dependencies in the project. All errors stem from missing package imports that should be provided by these dependencies.

errors.message: Missing Spring Security packages: config.annotation.web.builders, config.annotation.web.configuration, config.http, security.web
errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is not included in pom.xml. The SecurityConfig class requires Spring Security packages for @EnableWebSecurity, HttpSecurity, and SecurityFilterChain.

errors.message: Missing Spring Data packages: org.springframework.data.domain (Page, Pageable)
errors.root_cause: Spring Data JPA dependency is missing. Controllers and repositories require Spring Data domain classes for pagination support.

errors.message: Missing JPA repository packages: JpaRepository, Modifying, Query, Param annotations
errors.root_cause: Spring Data JPA dependency missing. Repository interfaces extend JpaRepository and use JPA query annotations which are not available.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add spring-boot-starter-data-jpa dependency to pom.xml (same as error #2). This will provide org.springframework.data.jpa.repository and org.springframework.data.repository.query packages.

errors.root_cause: Jakarta Persistence API is not available. Entity classes require jakarta.persistence package for JPA annotations. This should be included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa.
errors.fix_recommendation: Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa is added to pom.xml. If already added, verify the Spring Boot version includes Jakarta Persistence (3.x+). No separate jakarta.persistence dependency should be needed.

errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 dependency is not included in pom.xml. ValidationUtils class uses StringUtils or other Commons Lang3 utilities.
UserRepository extends JpaRepository but Spring Data JPA dependency is missing, causing the symbol to be unresolved.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add spring-boot-starter-data-jpa dependency to pom.xml (same fix as errors #2 and #3). This is a cascading error from the missing dependency.
